test_callback_invocation: test passing Python functions, partials, and lambdas as callbacks to C++ code via pybind11
test_bound_method_callback: test passing bound Python methods and C++ bound methods as callbacks to pybind11
test_keyword_args_unpacking: test tuple unpacking, dict unpacking, and keyword argument passing through pybind11 callbacks
test_lambda_closure_cleanup: test that lambda closures are properly cleaned up and verify C++ object construction statistics
test_cpp_function_roundtrip: test passing a C++ function pointer through Python and back to verify it matches the original
